title: Revisiting 402 — Careers & Creativity with Computational_Mama
summary: A re-airing of Divya's conversation with the creative technologist who goes by Computational Mama — about how she went from designing museum exhibitions to writing code as a creative tool, why the moniker gave her room to be more herself, and how a tinkerer father and a designer mother shaped her practice. She talks about creative coding when the examples were all STEM, performing code at Algorhythm India, and treating P5.js as a design tool rather than a CS pursuit.
topics: creative coding as a design tool
shifting from museum exhibition design to code

intents.display: to hear a designer talk about becoming a creative coder
